featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Devgharkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been servicing my Suzuki Access 125 at this service centre for the last five years. Unfortunately, my recent experience was highly disappointing.
At the time of handing over my vehicle for servicing, I was provided with an estimated cost of approximately ₹6,800. However, I was never informed that labour charges of such a substantial amount would be added to the bill. While approval for the work was obtained, no clarity whatsoever was given regarding the labour charges that would be levied.
To my shock, the final bill came to around ₹12,000 even after discounts. The labour charges alone were nearly equal to the cost of the parts and other service items. Such exorbitant labour charges are unreasonable and create an impression that the entire service centre was engaged in working on a single vehicle.
When I questioned these charges at the billing desk, no satisfactory explanation or detailed justification was provided. The staff simply failed to address a legitimate concern regarding the basis of the labour charges. Transparency in billing is a basic expectation, especially from an authorized service centre.
I was also expecting benefits under my AMC membership, but no meaningful advantage was evident. Further, the discount reflected in the bill appears to be more of a formality to show that some concession was granted rather than a genuine attempt to address the issue of excessive labour charges.
As a customer who has trusted this service centre for the last five years, I feel let down by the lack of transparency and poor customer communication. Customers should be clearly informed in advance about major labour costs and should not be surprised with inflated bills at the time of payment.
Very disappointed with the billing practices and the inability of the staff to justify the charges imposed.

featured_reviews.name: Vyankatesh Padelkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I bought an RTR 160 4V from this showroom in June 2025, and my experience has been very disappointing. I had made the full payment at the time of booking itself, yet still faced multiple issues.
Since the showroom is in Mahim and the godown is in Andheri, and the location was far from me, I could not inspect the bike before registration, trusting the showroom to deliver a proper new bike.
Delivery was delayed by 2–3 days because the bike was coming from the Andheri godown to the Mahim showroom, which caused inconvenience.
At the time of delivery, the bike did not have the usual plastic covers that a brand-new bike normally has. Later, I noticed that the manufacturing year is 2024, even though I purchased the bike in 2025.
First aid kit and toolkit were not provided. The odometer was already showing 15 km, and at the same time the odometer wire was not even connected, which raised serious concerns. It honestly felt like I was sold a demo or old bike.
I was in a hurry due to other work, so I ignored these issues at that time, which I now regret. After 7 months and 3 services, the bike is giving only 28 kmpl mileage, which is very poor for this model.
Overall, I am unhappy with the transparency and service. I strongly advise future customers to inspect the bike personally before registration and delivery, even if full payment is already done.
